subtopics.label: Kidney Allograft Monitoring and Rejection Diagnostics
subtopics.description: Research on noninvasive biomarkers and molecular diagnostics for kidney allograft rejection, including urinary cell mRNA profiling, RNA-sequencing, donor-derived cell-free DNA, and transcriptomic signatures for T-cell mediated and antibody-mediated rejection.

subtopics.label: Liver Transplantation Outcomes, Access, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Studies examining liver transplant waitlist access, outcomes, and disparities including racial and socioeconomic inequities, Medicaid expansion effects, alcohol-associated liver disease, obesity, and perioperative management.

subtopics.label: Heart Transplantation Outcomes and Complications
subtopics.description: Clinical research on heart transplant perioperative management, primary graft dysfunction, allograft vasculopathy, rejection, and long-term survival including effects of donor factors, recipient comorbidities, and allocation policy changes.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation Perioperative Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on perioperative and clinical outcomes in double-lung transplantation including primary graft dysfunction prediction, ECMO use, intraoperative factors, cystic fibrosis-specific outcomes, and lymphatic anastomosis.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation: GVHD, Engraftment, and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on hematopoietic cell transplantation outcomes including graft-versus-host disease prophylaxis, engraftment kinetics, cord blood transplantation, delirium, and perioperative complications in pediatric and adult populations.

subtopics.label: HCT Donor Matching, Access, and Racial Disparities
subtopics.description: Research on unrelated donor identification, HLA matching, racial and ethnic disparities in access to allogeneic transplantation, and tools to predict donor availability and transplant timing.

subtopics.label: Infectious Complications in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Studies on post-transplant infections including CMV, BK virus nephropathy, adenovirus, aspergillosis, gastrointestinal pathogens, and antibiotic effects on gut microbiota in solid organ and hematopoietic cell transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiota and Transplant Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining the role of gut microbiota composition in transplant recipients, including associations with urinary tract infections, post-transplant diarrhea, antibiotic perturbation, and colonization with resistant organisms.

subtopics.label: Kidney Transplant Donor Strategies and Recipient Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on kidney transplant donor strategies including HCV-positive donors, living donors, robotic surgical techniques, frailty assessment, dialysis nonadherence, and outcomes in HIV-infected recipients.

subtopics.label: CMV Immunity, Vaccination, and Immune Correlates in Transplantation
subtopics.description: Research on cytomegalovirus immune responses, vaccine development, antibody correlates of protection, and humoral immunity in transplant and non-transplant settings.

subtopics.label: Equity, Social Determinants, and Policy in Liver Transplantation
subtopics.description: Studies on social determinants of health, racial and gender disparities, insurance coverage, and policy interventions affecting liver transplant listing, access, and outcomes.

subtopics.label: Post-Transplant Malignancy and Immunosuppression-Related Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on malignancies arising in immunosuppressed transplant recipients, including cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, EBV-positive CNS lymphoma, and donor-derived acute myeloid leukemia.

subtopics.label: Pregnancy and Reproductive Outcomes in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Studies on reproductive counseling, pregnancy outcomes, and renal function in solid organ transplant recipients including uterus transplant recipients and women with chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: HCT for Lymphoma, Myeloma, and Myeloproliferative Neoplasms
subtopics.description: Clinical outcomes research on hematopoietic cell transplantation for hematologic malignancies including Hodgkin lymphoma, multiple myeloma, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and peripheral T-cell lymphoma.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Impact on Transplant Recipients and Programs
subtopics.description: Research on COVID-19 outcomes in kidney transplant recipients and waitlisted patients, and the broader impact of the pandemic on transplant program operations and non-COVID patient care.

subtopics.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia and Hematologic Malignancy Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on novel therapeutic agents and salvage regimens for acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and related hematologic malignancies, including targeted therapies and chemotherapy combinations.

subtopics.label: Myeloid Neoplasm Biology and Hematopoietic Stem Cell Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies examining the molecular and cellular biology of myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, and hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal, including epigenetic regulation and microenvironmental signaling.

subtopics.label: Islet and Beta Cell Transplantation and Engraftment
subtopics.description: Research on transplantation of pancreatic islets and beta cells, including vascularization strategies, subcutaneous engraftment, and small molecule approaches to enhance beta cell survival and function.

subtopics.label: Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease, Cirrhosis, and Prognosis
subtopics.description: Studies on alcohol use disorder and alcohol-associated liver disease including prognostic scoring, relapse prediction, patient-provider prognosis discordance, and clinical management of decompensated cirrhosis.

subtopics.label: Liver Allograft Rejection Diagnostics and HCC Treatment Response
subtopics.description: Research on noninvasive biomarkers such as serum microRNAs for diagnosing acute rejection in liver allografts, and imaging-based assessment of hepatocellular carcinoma treatment response using LI-RADS criteria.

subtopics.label: Pediatric HCT and Cancer Complications Including Bleeding and Vaccination
subtopics.description: Research on complications in pediatric hematopoietic cell transplant and cancer patients, including massive bleeding events, HPV vaccine uptake among HSCT survivors, and thrombotic microangiopathy.

subtopics.label: Cellular Therapy Product Processing and Cryopreservation
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating the effects of cryopreservation conditions and temporary storage on the viability and recovery of cellular therapy products used in transplantation.
